text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Barak wins clear victory in Labour party leadership election.
- Health Ministry considering class action lawsuit against cigarette manufacturers and importers.
- Top officials from British pharmaceutical companies visit Israel.
- Barak: "It's a first step towards leading Israel."
- Israeli security forces catch Gazan fishermen who smuggled guns into Gaza Strip.
- El Al employees to set up holding company to buy controlling interest in the airline once shares offered on Tel Aviv stock exchange.
- Netanyahu's economic adviser says Zim should be privatised through sale to strategic investor rather than by public offering.
- Five groups bidding for National Petroleum Company.
- Palestinian Authority receipts from donors total $1.5 billion.
